title: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing): Coverage-Loss Size Bands
content:
The coverage-loss amount of a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account (the total of its coverage-terminated liability postings) falls in one of three size bands.

| Coverage-loss amount | Percentage points added to the coverage-loss discount percent |
|---|---|
| at least 7500.00 | 5 |
| at least 2500.00, below 7500.00 | 2.5 |
| below 2500.00 | none |

**Clause.** A coverage-loss amount of at least 7500.00 USD adds 5 percentage points to the coverage-loss discount percent; one of at least 2500.00 but below 7500.00 adds 2.5 percentage points; a smaller one adds none.

*Band edges (hypothetical amounts).* 7500.00 adds 5 points and 7499.99 adds 2.5; 2500.00 adds 2.5 and 2499.99 adds none. Postings of 2000.00 and 600.00 total 2600.00 and add 2.5.
